author: Youcef Mammar
subject: feat(hooks): introduce `useQueryRules` (algolia/react-instantsearch#3212)
bodyLines: This adds `useQueryRule` to our Hooks collection. Similarly to the current API, the example implements
- `QueryRuleContext`: which applies ruleContexts based on filters to trigger context dependent Rules.
- `QueryRuleCustomData`:  which displays custom data from Rules.
This hook is a bridge to `connectQueryRule`.
